extracted.intended_audience: Potential grant applicants to the Foundation (people preparing Online Funding Inquiries and Final Proposals)
extracted.subtask_description: Official grant calendar and submission requirements for the Foundation's Online Funding Inquiry (OFI) and Final Proposal (FP) cycles, listing deadlines, decision-notice windows, and special notes (e.g., early closures, separate competitions).

rubrics_metrics.name: OFI submission requirement (Online Funding Inquiry)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Foundation invites you to submit your project idea through an Online Funding Inquiry (OFI).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Foundation will open the OFI application form several months before the submission deadline. OFI Deadline dates listed: July 15, 2026 | 11:59 PM EDT; August 15, 2025 | 11:59 PM EDT. Note the instruction: '*Please submit your request before the deadline.'

rubrics_metrics.name: OFI decision / notification timing
rubrics_metrics.description: Timeline for when applicants will be informed of OFI decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 2026 cycle: OFI Decision on a rolling basis between early September 2026 and October 9, 2026. 2025 cycle: By October 10, 2025.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final Proposal (FP) submission requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement and deadlines for submission of Final Proposals following OFI decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FP Deadline (2026 cycle): December 4, 2026 for most proposals. FP Deadline (2025 cycle): January 16, 2026 (or earlier for select proposals). Applicants should observe cycle-specific variations (some proposals may have earlier FP dates).

rubrics_metrics.name: Final Proposal decision / notice timing
rubrics_metrics.description: When applicants will be notified about FP decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FP Notice (2026 cycle): By July 9, 2027. FP Notice (2025 cycle): By July 10, 2026.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deadline timezone and punctuality requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Deadlines are specified with timezone and applicants must submit before the stated time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deadlines include timezone (e.g., 11:59 PM EDT). The page emphasizes submitting before the deadline and contains an asterisked note: 'Please submit your request before the deadline. Based on the volume and quality of requests, we may decide to close the application window early.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Possibility of early closure of application window
rubrics_metrics.description: The Foundation may close the application window before the posted deadline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because of volume and quality of requests, the Foundation may decide to close the application window early — applicants are advised to submit their request before the deadline to avoid missing an early closure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Separate Funding Competitions may follow different calendars
rubrics_metrics.description: Some funding opportunities (Funding Competitions) operate under their own calendar of deadlines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If there are any active funding competitions that operate under different grantmaking dates, they will be listed on the page; applicants should check for competition-specific dates rather than relying solely on the main OFI/FP calendar.

rubrics_metrics.name: OFI form availability notice
rubrics_metrics.description: Information about when the OFI form becomes available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Foundation will open the OFI application form several months before the submission deadline; applicants should monitor the site for the 'Apply Now' / OFI form availability.
